readings: Considering only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is more than 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. What is the simple average of these per-media-type averages? Return just that single value, unrounded.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY m.Name
);
